metadata.description: Bett3r internal AI development tooling: the project-agnostic vertical-slice workflow plus the PV3 DDD framework skills.

plugins.name: bett3r-ai-workflow
plugins.description: Vertical-slice, dual-gated development flow: grill the design, slice it (tracer bullet first), drive each slice to green with executor + verifier + test loop, commit per slice, land the PR as system of record. Project-agnostic — reads the host repo's conventions at runtime.

plugins.name: bett3r-pv3-ai-skills
plugins.description: PV3 DDD framework skills: scaffold event-sourced schemas, aggregates, policies, read models, modules, and tests, plus a ddd-patterns reference. Reads each host repo's packages/paths from .esas.config.json, so it works in any PV3 repo.
